shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc 'npm view @gravity-ui/page-constructor version peerDependencies && .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Text Button ThemeProvider'

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -C 2 'Header|Extended|Content|Card|Vite|CSS|Button|Provider' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/docs/INDEX.md | head -130 && cat vite.config.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/blocks/Header/Header.d.ts && rg -n -A 60 'interface HeaderBlock|interface ExtendedFeaturesBlock|interface ContentBlock|interface CardLayoutBlock' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/models/constructor-items/blocks.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "npm install -D sass vite-plugin-dynamic-import && rg -n -A 30 'interface Block|interface PageContent|interface TitleItem|type Block =|interface Animatable' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/models/{blocks,common,constructor-items/common}.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/blocks/ExtendedFeatures/ExtendedFeatures.css | head -100"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/blocks/ExtendedFeatures/ExtendedFeatures.js && rg -n 'var\\(--|padding|margin' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/blocks/{Header/Header,ExtendedFeatures/ExtendedFeatures,ContentLayout/ContentLayout}.css | head -90 && rg -n -A 30 'interface Block|interface PageContent|interface TitleItem|type Block =|interface Animatable' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/models/*.d.ts && sed -n '1,110p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/components/Title/Title.js"

/bin/bash -lc "npm install @gravity-ui/uikit@7.51.1 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/models/constructor-items/base.d.ts && sed -n '1,110p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/containers/PageConstructor/PageConstructor.d.ts && rg -n 'renderTitle|overtitle' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/blocks/Header/Header.js && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/components/BlockBase/BlockBase.css | head -85"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -A 22 'interface BlockBaseProps|type BlockIndent|enum BlockIndent' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/models/constructor-items/*.d.ts && rg -n 'renderTitle|overtitle' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/blocks/Header/Header.js && rg -n -- '--pc-|--g-' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/styles/variables.scss | head -55 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/components/BlockBase/BlockBase.css | head -70"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -A 8 'enum Theme|theme\\?:' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/context/theme/*.d.ts && rg -n -C 2 'Button|Text' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/INDEX.md | head -24 && rg -n -- '--g-button-padding|--g-button-border-radius' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/components/Button/README.md && rg -n -- '--g-color-(base-utility-heavy-hover|text-utility-heavy|line-utility|base-utility-light-hover)' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | head -12"

/bin/bash -lc "tail -20 /tmp/tempo-build.log && rg -n -- '--g-button-padding|--g-button-border-radius' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/components/Button.md && rg -n -- '--g-color-(base-utility-heavy-hover|text-utility-heavy|line-utility|base-utility-light-hover)' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | head -12 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/components/YFMWrapper/YFMWrapper.js | head -100 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/components/Buttons/Buttons.js | head -70"
